model.note: Part outlines are traced from Yamaha Motor Australia's photo of a green UMX EFI (no range cage) and are approximate. The engine, filters, drive belt, gearbox, fuel system, battery and brakes are hidden and are in the parts list. Specs come from the Yamaha Drive2 EFI 2020 owner's manual and need checking for this model; Yamaha's parts catalogue for model code J0G (gas EFI, serial 000101 on) is linked, and the bible has not yet been checked against it.

roof.name: Canopy roof
roof.desc: Check the body, chassis and the range cage or guards for damage daily, and that bolts, nuts and rivets are tight.

posts.name: Canopy front posts
posts.desc: Range use: check the picker, cage and guarding regularly (club note). Bolts, nuts and rivets tight (daily).

rearpost.name: Canopy rear post
rearpost.desc: Range use: check the picker, cage and guarding regularly (club note). Bolts, nuts and rivets tight (daily).

bed.name: Cargo bed
bed.desc: Check for damage and loose bolts or rivets daily.

bodyside.name: Body side panel
bodyside.desc: Check the body and chassis for damage daily.

fenderR.name: Rear fender
fenderR.desc: Check the body and chassis for damage daily.

cowl.name: Front cowl and fender
cowl.desc: Check the body for damage daily. The intake duct is a monthly check in the Yamaha chart (Drive2 EFI manual: confirm against the J0G owner's manual).

grille.name: Grille
grille.desc: Check for damage in the daily walk-around.

bumper.name: Front bumper
bumper.desc: Check for damage and that bolts are tight in the daily walk-around.

lights.name: Headlight
lights.desc: Checking the wiring is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual).

tyreFL.name: Front tyre, left
tyreFL.desc: Check tyre pressure and damage daily.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre, right
tyreFR.desc: Check tyre pressure and damage daily.

tyreRL.name: Rear tyre, left
tyreRL.desc: Check tyre pressure and damage daily. Checking the shock absorbers is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual).

seat.name: Seats
seat.desc: Daily walk-around: bolts, nuts and rivets tight and the reverse alarm works.

engine.name: Engine: petrol EFI (probably Yamaha 357 cc single)
engine.desc: Probably the Yamaha 357 cc single-cylinder OHV forced-air-cooled petrol EFI (Drive2 EFI powertrain): inferred, not confirmed. Unleaded petrol (ULP). Engine oil about 1.0 L: API SE or higher, JASO MA or MB, 10W-30 or 10W-40 (Drive2 EFI manual: confirm against the J0G owner's manual). Daily: oil between MIN and MAX on the dipstick, on level ground. Yamaha chart columns: initial 20 h, 125 h or 6 months, 250 h or 1 year, 500 h or 2 years, 1000 h or 4 years. The 125 h / 6 month items include replace engine oil, wash the pre-filter and check the air cleaner element, check the spark plug and cap, drive belt wear, starter V-belt, clean and lube the pedal area, brake cable, shocks, fuel hoses, wiring, speed limiter and intake duct (monthly). Which items fall at 125, 250 and 500 h was not legible online: copy the chart from the owner's manual. There is no PM template for this cart: the bible suggests a 6-monthly / 125 h service by date plus a monthly intake duct and tyre check.

sparkplug.name: Spark plug
sparkplug.desc: NGK BPR2ES, gap 0.7-0.8 mm (Drive2 EFI manual: confirm against the J0G owner's manual). Checking the plug and cap is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual).

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner and oil filter
aircleaner.desc: Washing the pre-filter and checking the air cleaner element is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual). Oil filter and air element numbers were not found: ask a Yamaha golf-car dealer, quoting serial J0G-000552.

belt.name: Drive V-belt and clutches
belt.desc: Drive2 EFI spec: 31.0 x 1010 mm, replace below 27.0 mm width (Drive2 EFI manual: confirm against the J0G owner's manual). Checking drive belt wear and the starter V-belt is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual). Primary and secondary clutch maintenance at 500 h or 2 years (dealer; confirm from the chart).

gearbox.name: Transmission / final gear
gearbox.desc: Oil about 0.475 L (spec not stated in the extract) (Drive2 EFI manual: confirm against the J0G owner's manual).

fuel.name: Fuel tank and hoses
fuel.desc: Unleaded petrol (ULP). Daily: fuel level and fuel line leaks. Checking the fuel hoses is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual). Tank capacity not found.

brakes.name: Brakes
brakes.desc: Daily: brake pedal free play. Checking the brake cable is a Yamaha chart item listed under 125 h / 6 months (confirm the interval in the owner's manual).
